name: termshare
description: Live-share your terminal from VS Code: start a termshare session, copy the viewer link, open the host in your browser.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Run the binary bundled with the extension (`bin/<platform-arch>/termshare`). On Windows this runs the Linux binary through WSL.
Run the binary at `termshare.path` (or `termshare` on `PATH`). On Windows it is still run through WSL.
Force running through `wsl`, using `termshare.path` if set, otherwise the bundled `linux-amd64` binary.
termshare.launchMode.markdownDescription: How to launch the termshare server. The PTY backend is Unix-only, so on Windows the binary always runs through WSL.

termshare.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `termshare` binary. Used when `termshare.launchMode` is `path`, or as an override for `wsl`. Leave empty to fall back to `termshare` on `PATH` (or the bundled binary for `wsl`).

termshare.addr.markdownDescription: Listen address passed to termshare as `-addr` (e.g. `:8080`). Leave empty to use the termshare default.

termshare.hostKey.markdownDescription: Fixed host key passed to termshare as `-host-key`. Leave empty for a random key each session.
